# `browser-tab open`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab open [FLAGS] <url>`

Open an http(s) URL in a new tab

## Arguments

### `<url>`

## Flags

### `--browser <name>`

chrome|chromium|brave|safari

### `--window <id>`

Open in a specific window (opaque windowId)

### `--no-activate`

Open in the background
